identity.title: Celestial Globe of Light and Shadow

leadText: (Japanese: ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ 光と影のテンキュウギ Best Wishes!: Celestial Globe of Light and Shadow) is an animated series special that was shown at various planetariums and museums in Japan, being the fourth of such specials.
plainText:
(Japanese: ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ 光と影のテンキュウギ Best Wishes!: Celestial Globe of Light and Shadow) is an animated series special that was shown at various planetariums and museums in Japan, being the fourth of such specials.

==Blurb==
 
When Ash and friends are admiring the night sky, Team Rocket sneaks up on them and steals Pikachu. Pursuing, Ash and friends end up in some mysterious ancient ruins. Will Ash be able to unravel the secrets of the Celestial Globe and save Pikachu?
